target: UTM-bundled QEMU, HVF, AArch64 graphical guest, one vCPU, VirtIO keyboard/tablet and VirtIO Sound
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -audiodev wav,id=sound0,path=build/ohgreat-8181de3-2026-11-12.wav -device virtio-sound-pci,audiodev=sound0' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-ohgreat-8181de3-qemu-2026-11-12.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-ohgreat-full
verified: The stock song reached its late lyric and accepted a normal-key exit.
The graphical terminal resumed, evaluated 40+2 as 42, and zstatus reported failed=0.
VirtIO Sound captured a 47.22-second stereo 44.1 kHz, 16-bit WAV; peak sample was 7000 and RMS was 6901.89.
scope_note: This establishes full-song execution and a non-silent captured output stream on the exact current ISO under UTM-bundled QEMU. It does not establish audible playback in the visible UTM app or Pi HDMI/headphone output for this exact image.
